pure-announcement.rationale: It is a program landing page of navigation fragments rather than a launch, release note, or funding announcement, even though it promotes the PF 1.1 draft.

duplicate.rationale: The corpus has no concept on privacy risk management frameworks, so nothing here duplicates an existing note.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The little the page asserts — that the NIST Privacy Framework exists as a voluntary tool and that a 1.1 draft was published — is verifiable at the linked NIST primary sources.

durability.rationale: The capture is navigation chrome, image links, video promos, and mailing-list signup instructions; the framework's actual content lives behind links and none of it made it into the note.

actionability.rationale: There is nothing to act on beyond following links that were not captured — no category, subcategory, or usage guidance from the framework itself is present.

atomicity.rationale: The only statable core is the one-line existence fact that NIST publishes a voluntary privacy-risk framework, with no developed idea behind it independent of the page's link-hub framing.
